## LLM gateway
The only workflow that talks to an LLM provider, so the provider can be swapped in one place (Gemini today).
**In:** one item per request, `{ purpose, model, system, prompt, schema, temperature, max_output_tokens }`, from Workflow A (crawl-time extraction), Workflow B or the warm step (fuzzy cohorts). Several requests go out `llm_concurrency` at a time, paced under `llm_rpm`.
**Out:** one item per request, in request order: `{ request_index, ok, data, error, calls, tokens_in, tokens_out }`, always this shape.
Guards: the daily free-tier budget (`llm_rpd`) is checked before every call (**Load app_config** reads the switches and today's usage in one query, so a call costs two database round trips: that one and the log). 429/5xx responses back off (honouring RetryInfo) up to `llm_max_retries`. Every attempt is logged in `llm_calls`.

parameters.query:
-- LLM gateway, first statement: every app_config switch as one JSON object (as in
-- sql/common/load_config.sql) and the provider requests that count against today's free-tier
-- quota, in one round trip (docs/DECISIONS.md AD27). Gemini resets requests-per-day at midnight
-- Pacific time, so the day is measured in that zone. Rate-limited attempts are rejected by the
-- provider and don't consume the quota.
SELECT (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) FROM app_config) AS config,
       (SELECT count(*)
        FROM llm_calls
        WHERE outcome <> 'rate_limited'
          AND created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
                             AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')) AS calls_today;

-- LLM gateway: record one provider request.
-- Parameters: #1 execution id, #2 purpose, #3 provider, #4 model, #5 attempt, #6 http status,
--             #7 outcome, #8 tokens in, #9 tokens out, #10 duration ms, #11 error
INSERT INTO llm_calls (execution_id, purpose, provider, model, attempt, http_status, outcome,
                       tokens_in, tokens_out, duration_ms, error)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::smallint, $6::integer, $7, $8::integer, $9::integer,
        $10::integer, $11)
RETURNING call_id;
